entry.title: Mini Israel · Outdoor amphitheater
entry.note: The oblique park photograph and north-up overhead image identify the full-size amphitheater at the southeast edge. Its stage faces northeast toward the stepped seats. The fitted footprint clears the surrounding PMTiles buildings and water, and the west side follows the visitor path. Preview places the authored base at the recorded absolute sea-level elevation; local tide and terrain resolution remain host-dependent.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
